_comment: OpenScent extraction test set v0. One JSON object per line. label: keep|drop. Every sentence is REAL text from the named US patent, observed during hand-runs 01-03 (2026-07-31/08-01). 'partial' means the sentence was truncated in capture — usable for filter decisions, NOT for verbatim-span testing. READ pipeline/TESTSET.md BEFORE TRUSTING ANY SCORE FROM THIS FILE.

label: drop
why: ANAPHORIC: 'the material' + 'in the latter case' point to a compound named in an earlier sentence. Same principle as t11 — a row needs a resolvable molecule — but a different cause: t11 ('feedstock') can NEVER resolve, t10 could resolve WITH CONTEXT the sentence-level filter cannot see. Relabelled 2026-08-01 so the score does not penalise the filter for lacking anaphora resolution, which is a feature not a regex. Cost measured: 85 of 987 v3-rejected sentences (9%) look anaphoric. Revisit if the corpus comes up short.
